boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain St Bonaventure University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and convenience stops with published evening or overnight availability in Saint Bonaventure and nearby Olean.

cards.title: Randy's Fireside
cards.subtitle: 1644 Haskell Road, Olean
cards.notes: Use the published address and phone to confirm service before leaving campus; the restaurant lists daily hours through 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant in Olean with the latest published closing time in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Randy's Fireside lists hours of 11 a.m. to 2 a.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: daily, 11 a.m.–2 a.m.; confirm kitchen availability directly.

cards.title: Wendy's on North Union
cards.subtitle: 447 N Union St, Olean
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, pickup, or drive-thru as appropriate; Wendy's location page lists both restaurant and drive-thru service until 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food stop with daily 1 a.m. restaurant and drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wendy's at 447 N Union St lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10 a.m. to 1 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are published daily until 1 a.m.

cards.title: Eatery Olean
cards.subtitle: 239 N Union St, Olean
cards.notes: Plan for Friday or Saturday if seeking the latest listed service; its official contact page posts an 11 p.m. close on those nights.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Olean restaurant with Friday and Saturday evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Eatery Olean lists Friday and Saturday business hours of 11 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published Friday–Saturday hours end at 11 p.m.; it is closed Sunday and Monday.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on North Union
cards.subtitle: 610 N Union St, Olean
cards.notes: Use the location’s carryout or delivery ordering options; Friday and Saturday restaurant hours are posted through 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A pizza option with published 11 p.m. weekend restaurant hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut at 610 N Union St lists restaurant hours until 11 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — 610 N Union St, Olean
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are published until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Hickey Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: St. Bonaventure University campus
cards.notes: Check the academic-calendar context before relying on it; the university catalog lists dining options at Hickey from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: Campus dining with a published 10 p.m. endpoint.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Bonaventure's undergraduate catalog states that Hickey Dining Hall offers dining options from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: St. Bonaventure University Undergraduate Catalog — General Information
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; dining service follows the academic calendar.

cards.entity_name: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery — 2728 West State Street
cards.title: Perkins on West State
cards.subtitle: 2728 West State Street, Olean
cards.notes: Use the official location page for pickup, curbside, or delivery details; it lists daily restaurant hours ending at 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A full-service restaurant and bakery with daily 10 p.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins at 2728 West State Street lists restaurant hours of 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Published restaurant hours: 6 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Subway at Walmart Plaza
cards.subtitle: 1869 Plaza Dr, Olean
cards.notes: Confirm the store rather than the broader Walmart schedule; Subway’s official page lists its daily store hours through 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich stop with published daily 10 p.m. store hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway at 1869 Plaza Dr lists store hours of 7:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Published daily store hours end at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Great Wall
cards.subtitle: 700 W State St #3, Olean
cards.notes: Use the official ordering link for pickup and confirm the day; Great Wall’s site posts 8:30 p.m. closing on its open days.
cards.short_summary: A pickup-focused Olean food stop with posted evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Great Wall lists hours through 8:30 p.m. Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours end at 8:30 p.m. on open days; closed Wednesday.

cards.title: 7-Eleven on North Union
cards.subtitle: 607 N Union St, Olean
cards.notes: Use this convenience stop for items sold in-store; the official store page identifies it as open around the clock and lists hot foods.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 convenience store with hot-food availability listed.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven at 607 N Union St is listed as open 24/7 and includes hot foods among its store features.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the store as open 24/7.

cards.title: 7-Eleven on West State
cards.subtitle: 131 W State St, Olean
cards.notes: Use the official store page to check store features and delivery availability; this distinct Olean location is posted as open 24/7.
cards.short_summary: A second 24/7 convenience-store option in downtown Olean.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven at 131 W State St is listed as open 24/7 and includes hot foods among its store features.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the store as open 24/7.
